# Thai Roots · รากศัพท์

> A Hans Wehr-style root dictionary of Thai: Pali and Sanskrit roots, native morpheme
> families, sound-change keys, and a decomposer that takes a word apart. One page,
> offline-capable, bilingual Thai and English.

- [The dictionary](https://nanobotco.github.io/thairoots/)
- [Privacy](https://nanobotco.github.io/thairoots/privacy-policy.html)
- [Source](https://github.com/NaNoBotCo/thairoots)
- [How to cite this](https://nanobotco.github.io/thairoots/CITATION.cff)
